diagnostic_interpretation: The Green-Ampt one-bin identity passes in all 256 frozen cases despite a nonzero absolute binary64 residual at large magnitude.
The failed checks are concentrated in identities that reconstruct small differences from rounded endpoint quantities before division by small delta-theta.

A reproduced gravity-case worst ratio is about 11.38 times the frozen naive roundoff tolerance while the expected velocity magnitude is about 3.90e5 cm/day; this is consistent with conditioning amplification rather than a structural equation mismatch.
A reproduced pure-capillary worst ratio is about 19.11 times the frozen naive tolerance with an absolute residual of order 7.2e-13.
The frozen B2C tolerance model did not include forward-error amplification from forming theta_d-theta_i and K_d-K_i from independently rounded endpoints.
hard_guards: B2C remains FAIL and its frozen thresholds are not relaxed post hoc.

A follow-up must compare the same source algebra against a high-precision oracle and explicitly distinguish endpoint-derived differences from shared immutable delta-theta and delta-K parameters.
